messages:
alex_w: Quick sync — partner/reseller deals keep asking for transferable burst, resale-friendly quotas, and lower per-token for embedded use. We don't have a clear playbook for entitlements + legal exceptions. Can we sketch one?

maya: Can you paste a concrete ask from a deal so we can scope?

jordan_m: Example from Acme partner: they want to resell to their customers. Needs per-customer sub-accounts, ability to move unused commit between sub-accounts, and 18mo commit shelf-life. Also requested that overage rates be at 60% of our public rate.

samir: Seems like two orthogonal things: billing/quotas vs. licensing/legal. Product can support per-sub-account quotas + transfer API but pricing delta needs commercial approval.

liz_s: Legal note: we can't permit transfer of customer data w/o explicit DPA addendum and subprocessors list. Also resale may trigger export/compliance checks depending on customer geos.

alex_w: Proposed minimal product requirements to ship a "Reseller Entitlement" add-on:
```
- Per-subaccount quotas (commit + burst)
- Transfer API for moving commit between subaccounts (admin only)
- Billing mapping: bill partner for aggregate + line-item per subaccount for transparency
- Audit logs for transfers and usage (30d retention initial)
- Contract flag in console to toggle resale entitlements
```

maya: That looks good. UX work: need admin UI for partner admins and an integration point for our billing system (CPA). I'll estimate a week of PM + 2 sprints eng.

jordan_m: Pricing options I see: (A) flat % discount on all tokens for resellers, (B) slot-based addon (X subaccounts + Y commits), (C) hybrid: commit pool + volume tiers. I'd push (C).

samir: Implementation note: quota enforcement needs to work across Dedicated/Private/Hosted. For Private we can expose the same config but mark "self-managed billing"; contracts still required.

liz_s: From legal side we need: DPA reseller addendum, clause prohibiting model tampering, and an audit right. Also define geography restrictions. I'll draft language but need product/ops to confirm technical guardrails.

alex_w: Launch criteria proposal:
- Feature parity in Hosted + Dedicated for enforcement
- Billing export line items for partner finance
- DPA + reseller addendum drafted and reviewed
- E2E smoke test (create partner, create subaccount, transfer commit, simulate overage)
- Security review signoff

maya: Action items:
- maya: create product ticket (est. 1 week)
- samir: prototype transfer API + quota enforcement (spike, 3 days)
- liz_s: draft reseller addendum (EOW)
- jordan_m: propose pricing bands + example P&L for partner (EOW)

alex_w: If we can get the legal template + spike done, we can pilot with 1 partner next month. Who owns partner onboarding flow?

jordan_m: I'll own onboarding docs and the sample contract appendix.

legal-bot: Reminder: compliance checklist required for resellers includes SOC attestation, export controls verification, and SOC/Security questionnaire.

alex_w: Cool. Let's reconvene Fri morning for status. :thumbsup:
